## What it needs {#needs}

Its scripts can call 150 script bindings. 15 of them are new, which no earlier level of the story calls: 2 are
implemented in Coney and 15 are traced. The full list is on [the coverage
page](../references/bindings/story.md#level60).

| Family | New bindings | In Coney |

## Run it in Coney {#run}

With your own disc ([Playing a level](../guides/building.md#playing-a-level)); `--checkpoint` picks where it starts, 1
to 3:

```text
coney --disc /path/to/disc --play-level level60 --checkpoint 1
```
